heading: Authorization of appropriations
lead: There is authorized to be appropriated such sums as may be necessary to carry out the purposes of this subchapter.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section was formerly classified to section 1694e of this title.

notes.heading: Effective Date
notes.text: For effective date of this section, see section 1825 of this title and Effective Date of Constitution note thereunder.
